'''Esenler Erokspor Kulübü''' is a Turkish professional [[sports club]] based in [[Esenler]], [[Istanbul]]. Founded on 16 November 1959, the club is best known for its football department, which currently competes in the [[TFF First League]], the second tier of the [[Turkish football league system]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageID=28&kulupID=12727 |title=ESENLER EROKSPOR - Club Details TFF |website=Turkish Football Federation |date=2026-02-28 |access-date=2026-02-28}}</ref> The team plays its home matches at the [[Esenler Stadium]] (also known as Esenler Erokspor Stadium), which has an all-seater capacity of 5,291.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageID=394&stadID=1846 |title=Stadium Details: ESENLER EROKSPOR STADYUMU |website=Turkish Football Federation |date=2026-02-28 |access-date=2026-02-28}}</ref>

Esenler Erokspor achieved significant success in the mid-2020s, earning promotion to the TFF First League as champions of the [[TFF Second League]] following the 2023–24 season. After finishing 12th in their debut First League campaign in 2024–25, the club emerged as a promotion contender for the [[Süper Lig]] during the 2025–26 season. Under the management of head coach [[Osman Özköylü]], who was appointed in March 2025, the team maintained a high league position throughout early 2026, including a notable five-match winning streak in February that solidified their second-place standing.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.haberturk.com/igdir-haberleri/112648432-igdir-fk-esenler-erokspor-macinin-ardindan-igdir-fk-teknik-direktoru-kocak-tribunlere-ozur |title=Esenler Erokspor Teknik Direktörü Özköylü: "Planladığımızı sahaya yansıttık" |website=Habertürk |date=2026-02-21 |access-date=2026-02-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fotmob.com/teams/791331/overview/esenler-erokspor |title=Esenler Erokspor - fixtures, team info and top players |website=FotMob |date=2026-02-28 |access-date=2026-02-28}}</ref> Key players during this period included top scorer [[Olarenwaju Kayode]], [[Hamza Čataković]], and [[Ryan Jack]], with the squad further bolstered by the loan signing of [[Ömer Faruk Beyaz]] in January 2026.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tribuna.com/en/teams/erokspor/transfers/ |title=Esenler Erokspor Transfers 2026 Winter |website=Tribuna.com |date=2026-01-03 |access-date=2026-02-28}}{{dead link|date=May 2026|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref>

In addition to football, the club operates a professional basketball division, known as Safiport Erokspor for sponsorship reasons, which competes in the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/basketball-Safiport-Erokspor.asp |title=Esenler Erokspor Istanbul basketball, News, Roster, Rumors, Stats |website=Eurobasket |date=2026-02-28 |access-date=2026-02-28}}</ref><ref name=TFF>{{cite web|url=https://www.tff.org/Default.aspx?pageId=535&kulupID=964|title=Club Details|website=www.tff.org|access-date=1 March 2024}}</ref>"}}
